source: North Carolina State Board of Elections

c.t: Constitutional Amendment - Require Photo ID for Voting
c.q: Constitutional amendment to require all voters not just those presenting to vote in person to present photo identification before voting.

c.t: Constitutional Amendment - Maximum Income Tax Rate of 3.5%
c.q: Constitutional amendment to keep the State income tax rate from being raised higher than three and one-half percent (3.5%).

c.t: Constitutional Amendment - Property Tax Levy Limit
c.q: Constitutional amendment requiring limits on property tax increases by local governments.

c.t: Columbus County Malt Beverage Election
c.q: To permit the on-premises and off-premises sale of malt beverages.

c.t: Columbus County Unfortified Wine Election
c.q: To permit the on-premises and off-premises sale of unfortified wine.

c.t: Columbus County Mixed Beverage Election
c.q: To permit the sale of mixed beverages in hotels restaurants private clubs community theatres and convention centers and the on-premises and off-premises sale of malt beverages and unfortified wine in qualified establishments.

c.t: Columbus County Local Sales and Use Tax Referendum
c.q: Local sales and use tax at the rate of one-quarter percent (0.25%) in addition to all other State and local sales and use taxes.
